subject: dpi.pay
name: Interoperable transfer fee
movement: Advanced, at the interoperability layer only
position_start: Up to RWF 5,000 per interoperable transfer
position_end: A maximum of RWF 20, not a flat charge, on the four interoperable legs between banks and electronic money issuers - account-to-wallet, wallet-to-account, account-to-account and wallet-to-wallet - with institutions free to charge less or nothing, and each operator's own on-net tariff untouched; the ceiling holds regardless of amount up to the RWF 10m per-transaction limit
note: Reconcile 2026-08-09: settled - RWF 20 is a ceiling, not a flat charge, and it prices the interoperability layer only. The Rwanda Bankers' Association public notice of 2026-07-14, the participating institutions' own statement, puts it as "a maximum fee of RWF 20, with institutions free to offer lower or zero-fee options", applying to "every transfer between banks and electronic money issuers". The instrument is BNR Directive No. 45/2026 and it is not held: the BNR document library was enumerated on 2026-08-09 (493 documents) and carries neither the directive nor the 2026-07-13 public notice, and the directive's issue date is given as 9 January 2026 by the Bankers' Association and 9 June 2026 by Taarifa, so it is unestablished. What governs on-net tariffs is likewise unestablished; nothing on file sets one.
